documents.title: Executive Order 14436: Implementing the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026
documents.text: The rate of duty on goods from the Russian Federation shall be increased by 500 percent ad valorem. The rate of duty on goods from the largest 5 importers of crude oil and natural gas from the Russian Federation shall be increased by 100 percent ad valorem. The application of any duties provided for in sections 112 and 113 of the Act is waived. Sanctions imposed with respect to the harmful activities of the Government of the Russian Federation remain in effect.

documents.title: Trump waives Russia-related sanctions before they kick in, prompting backlash from Ukraine and US lawmakers
documents.lead: President Trump issued an executive order waiving Russia-related duties under the Graham Act before they took effect. Lawmakers from both parties and officials in Ukraine criticized the waiver.
